Prices doubled every 15 hours 💸

Hungary, 1946: the pengő suffered the worst hyperinflation ever recorded, about 41 quadrillion percent in July 1946 alone. Paid on Monday, your salary was worth a ninth by Wednesday. The country even printed a 100 quintillion pengő note, the biggest ever printed.

And number two on the list? It happened right next door. 👀

▶️ All ten of the worst currency collapses in history are on our YouTube channel (link in bio): https://youtu.be/sSP3BO9pGyk

Education, not financial advice.
